paletteOrigin: assets/source/old-site/cover2.png (Season One sleeve, watercolour by Julia Feisleben)

motion.wordmarkSoakIn: opacity 0 to 1, background-size 150% 260% to 100% 100%, saturate 0.3 to 1, 1900ms ease-out-expo, runs once, never loops
motion.hypeSticker: transform 240ms ease-out-expo, rotate -8deg to -4deg on hover
motion.reducedMotion: the wordmark renders finished with no animation; smooth scrolling off
motion.webgl: none; the site ships no canvas and no animation library
motion.backgroundWaves: three keyframe sets (71s, 82s, 104s) on ease-in-out alternate, transform only, staggered per mark, none under reduced motion
motion.printHover: translateY(-3px) with a deeper sleeve shadow, 320ms ease-out-expo
motion.lyricsPanel: sheet-in 260ms ease-out-expo on open; native dialog handles focus, Escape and return

wordmark.contrastGuard: the generator fails if any part of the wash drops under 3:1 against #f3f2f0

stains.technique: the paint's own density becomes an alpha channel, edges and corners faded so no crop leaves a rectangle; the file carries shape only
stains.usage: mask-image over a token colour, 0.16-0.34 opacity, two or three per section, decorative, inside the section, hidden under forced colours and where masks are unsupported; never scale the mask past 100%, which would cut the faded edge into a rectangle

releaseTheming.guard: the generator refuses an accent under 4.5:1 on paper or a wash under 12:1 with ink; tests/unit/release-palette.test.ts asserts it
